title: Resolved Addresses: Only show used services
description:
Keep the custom services entries in a separate table and
only copy them to the externally visible table when looked up.
This allows us to make the externally visible strings const,
and means that we don't have to copy the strings from the global
services C array table.

It also means that the externally visible table only has entries
that have actually been looked up, instead of being mixed with
the static entries.

Fix #13857
